acp.title: Antigravity and ACP
acp.stateFile: State file on the daemon host
acp.note: Add this rule to your ACP provider's instructions. Enable Paseo tool injection and reopen the session to expose the tool.
acp.snippet: At the start of each task, call the Paseo tool agent_team_status and follow its current mode and instructions. If it is unavailable, only use the local fallback when PASEO_AGENT_TEAM_MODE is set. Read {{path}} on the daemon host and look up agents[PASEO_AGENT_ID] if the ID is available. If there is no entry, use the launch values PASEO_AGENT_TEAM_MODE and PASEO_AGENT_TEAM_WORKER. When delegating with create_agent, always include labels: { "agent-team/role": "worker" }.
